name: Ishigaki (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ishigaki city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ishigaki, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 April 1967.

features.role: Ishigaki city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a ring
